lastCompletedStory.title: cam patterns archive CLI wiring + help + sentinel

nextStoryContext: `cam patterns archive` is wired in index.ts exactly like `cam journal archive` (parsePatternsArgs / dispatchPatterns / PatternsDispatchDeps / defaultPatternsArchiveFn / PATTERNS_HELP, case 'patterns' in the main switch, top-level HELP entry) but simplified: no --threshold flag (archival is marker-based per US-001's RESOLVED_MARKER_RE), no stdin read, no --force/--cycle-close. Bare `cam patterns` (no subcommand) prints PATTERNS_HELP and exits 0 -- this deliberately diverges from `cam journal`'s bare-invocation error, since patterns has only one subcommand so there's nothing to disambiguate (documented as a patterns.md bullet). Sentinels: `CAM_PATTERNS_ARCHIVED=<n> sha=<sha>` on a successful archive, `CAM_PATTERNS_ARCHIVE=noop` on no marked bullets, exit 1 on any ArchivePatternsOnMainError. US-003 (best-effort patterns archive on the --cycle-close path) should mirror dispatchJournal's US-003 wiring: call archivePatternsOnMain (via the same injectable archiveFn shape used here) after CAM_JOURNAL_APPENDED/recordCycleTokens and before the recycle marker is armed inside dispatchJournal's --cycle-close branch (index.ts ~line 1575-1593), best-effort (a throw or ok:false only logs a printWarning, never changes the exit code). US-004 (retrofit 2026-06 build-notes markers) needs the exact `[resolved YYYY-MM]` regex US-001 defined (RESOLVED_MARKER_RE, exported from src/commands/patterns-archive.ts) and should document the marking convention (probably a new patterns.md preamble line or a CLAUDE.md note) so future contributors know how to mark a bullet resolved by hand.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure CLI-dispatch wiring in index.ts (argv parsing, injectable deps, stdout sentinels) mirroring the existing cam journal archive dispatch shape; no external library surface was exercised or changed.
